summary_1line: Prince Uttara marvels at and questions the ownership of a vast array of ornate bows, arrows, quivers, and swords discovered with Vrihannala.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prince Uttara stands wide‑eyed before a hidden cache of glittering bows, quivers, and swords studded with gold and gems.
Uttara lifts a magnificent bow studded with a hundred golden bosses, its polished curve shining in the light.
Rows of arrows with golden heads and bright feathered wings lie in ornate quivers as Uttara points at them in astonishment.
